postgresql_version: PostgreSQL 18.4 (Debian 18.4-1.pgdg13+1) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

cases.name: folded_repeated
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH x AS NOT MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) SELECT a.column1 FROM x a CROSS JOIN x b

cases.name: folded_definition_scope
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) SELECT * FROM (WITH a AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM x), x AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2)) SELECT * FROM x CROSS JOIN a) s

cases.name: quoted
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH "Quoted Name" AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2)) SELECT * FROM "Quoted Name"

cases.name: escaped_quote
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH "quoted""name" AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2)) SELECT * FROM "quoted""name"

cases.name: quoted_dot
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH "a.b" AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2)) SELECT * FROM "a.b"

cases.name: recursive_forward
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH RECURSIVE a AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM b), b AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2)) SELECT * FROM a

cases.name: unused
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH unused AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2)) SELECT 7

cases.name: unused_volatile
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH unused AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT random()) SELECT 7

cases.name: preceding_scope
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) SELECT * FROM (WITH a AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM x), x AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2)) SELECT * FROM x CROSS JOIN a) s

cases.name: shadow
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) SELECT * FROM (WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2)) SELECT * FROM x) local_x CROSS JOIN x

cases.name: dependency
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH a AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2)), b AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM a) SELECT * FROM b

cases.name: repeated
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) SELECT * FROM x a CROSS JOIN x b

cases.name: blocking_repeated
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) AS v(n) ORDER BY n) SELECT a.n FROM x a CROSS JOIN x b

cases.name: scalar
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM x)

cases.name: nested_dependency
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, SUMMARY FALSE, COSTS TRUE) WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2),(3)), a AS MATERIALIZED (WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2)) SELECT * FROM x) SELECT * FROM a CROSS JOIN x
